verses.geez: ትትፌሣሕ፡ መካን፡ እንተ፡ ኢትወልድ፤ ትኬልሕ፡ ወተአወዩ፡ እንተ፡ ኢተሐምም፤ እስመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ውሉዳ፡ ለመዓስብ፡ እምእንተ፡ ባቲ፡ ምተ።
verses.translation: Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that dost not travail: for more are the children of the desolate than of her that has a husband: for the Lord has said,

translations.lxx: Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that dost not travail: for more are the children of the desolate than of her that has a husband: for the Lord has said,
translations.kjv: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
translations.ron: Veseleşte-te, cea stearpă, care nu năşteai, dă glas şi strigă tu care nu te-ai zvârcolit în dureri de naştere, căci mai mulţi sunt fiii celei părăsite, decât ai celei cu bărbat, zice Domnul.
translations.grk: Εὐφράνθητι στεῖρα ἡ οὐ τίκτουσα, ῥῆξον καὶ βόησον ἡ οὐκ ὠδίνουσα, ὅτι πολλὰ τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐρήμου, μᾶλλον ἢ τῆς ἐχούσης τὸν ἄνδρα· εἶπε γὰρ Κύριος,

verses.geez: አርሒቢ፡ መታክለ፡ ዘደብተራኪ፤ ወትክሊ፡ ዐፀደኪ፡ ወኢትምሐኪ፤ አንኂኬ፡ አሕባለኪ፡ ወአጽንዒ፡ መታክለኪ።
verses.translation: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and of thy curtains: fix the pins, spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy pins;

translations.lxx: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and of thy curtains: fix the pins, spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy pins;
translations.kjv: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
translations.ron: Lărgeşte locul cortului tău şi acoperământul sălaşului tău întinde-l, nu cruţa nimic! Lungeşte funiile şi întăreşte ţăruşii!
translations.grk: πλάτυνον τὸν τόπον τῆς σκηνῆς σου, καὶ τῶν αὐλαιῶν σου, πῆξον, μὴ φείσῃ, μάκρυνον τὰ σχοινίσματά σου, καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους σου κατίσχυσον,

verses.geez: ዓዲ፡ ለፀጋም፡ ወለየማን፡ አንጦልዒ፤ እስመ፡ ዘርእኪ፡ ይወርሱ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወትነብሪ፡ አህጉረ፡ መዝበረ።
verses.translation: spread forth thy tent yet to the right and the left: for thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and thou shalt make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

translations.lxx: spread forth thy tent yet to the right and the left: for thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and thou shalt make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
translations.kjv: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
translations.ron: Căci tu te vei lăţi la dreapta şi la stânga şi seminţia ta va cuceri neamurile şi cetăţile cele pustiite le va umple de oameni.
translations.grk: ἔτι εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ καὶ τὰ ἀριστερὰ ἐκπέτασον· καὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου ἔθνη κληρονομήσει, καὶ πόλεις ἠρημωμένας κατοικιεῖς.

verses.geez: ኢትፍርሂ፡ እስመ፡ ተኀፈርኪ፡ ወኢትኅፈሪ፡ እስመ፡ ጸዐሉኪ፤ ወትረስዒ፡ ኃፍረተኪ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ ወኢትዜከርዮ፡ ለጽዕለትኪ፡ ዘአመ፡ ማዕሰብኪ።
verses.translation: Fear not, because thou hast been put to shame, neither be confounded, because thou wast reproached: for thou shalt forget thy former shame, and shalt no more at all remember the reproach of thy widowhood.

translations.lxx: Fear not, because thou hast been put to shame, neither be confounded, because thou wast reproached: for thou shalt forget thy former shame, and shalt no more at all remember the reproach of thy widowhood.
translations.kjv: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
translations.ron: Nu te înfricoşa, căci nu vei rămâne de ocară; nu te ruşina, căci nu vei avea de ce să te ruşinezi; că tu vei uita ruşinea tinereţii tale şi de ocara văduviei tale nu-ti vei mai aduce aminte.
translations.grk: Μὴ φοβοῦ, ὅτι κατῃσχύνθης, μηδὲ ἐντραπῇς, ὅτι ὠνειδίσθης, ὅτι αἰσχύνην αἰώνιον ἐπιλήσῃ, καὶ ὄνειδος τῆς χηρείας σου οὐ μὴ μνησθήσῃ ἔτι.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ለኪ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ ስሙ፤ ወውእቱ፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ዘአድኀነኪ፡ ዘይሰመይ፡ በኵሉ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: For it is the Lord that made thee; the Lord of hosts is his name: and he that delivered thee, he is the God of Israel, and shall be called so by the whole earth.

translations.lxx: For it is the Lord that made thee; the Lord of hosts is his name: and he that delivered thee, he is the God of Israel, and shall be called so by the whole earth.
translations.kjv: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
translations.ron: Căci bărbatul tău este Făcătorul tău, şi numele Lui: Domnul Savaot şi Răscumpărătorul tău este Sfântul lui Israel: "Dumnezeul a tot pământul" se cheamă!
translations.grk: Ὅτι Κύριος ὁ ποιῶν σε, Κύριος σαβαὼθ ὄνομα αὐτῷ· καὶ ὁ ῥυσάμενός σε, αὐτὸς Θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ, πάσῃ τῇ γῇ κληθήσεται.

verses.geez: አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ብእሲት፡ ኅድግት፡ ወዕንብዝት፡ ዘጸውዐኪ፡ እግዚአብሔር፣፡ ወአኮ፡ ከመ፡ ብእሲት፡ ጽዕልት፡ እምንእሳ፡ ይቤ፡ አምላክኪ።
verses.translation: The Lord has not called thee as a deserted and faint-hearted woman, nor as a woman hated from her youth, saith thy God.

translations.lxx: The Lord has not called thee as a deserted and faint-hearted woman, nor as a woman hated from her youth, saith thy God.
translations.kjv: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
translations.ron: Ca pe o femeie părăsită şi cu inima întristată te cheamă Domnul; ca pe soţia din tinereţe care a fost alungată; zice Dumnezeul tău.
translations.grk: Οὐχ ὡς γυναῖκα καταλελειμμένην καὶ ὀλιγόψυχον κέκληκέ σε ὁ Κύριος, οὐδʼ ὡς γυναῖκα ἐκ νεότητος μεμισημένην, εἶπεν ὁ Θεός σου.

verses.geez: ኅዳጠ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኀደጉኪ፡ ወበዓቢይ፡ ምሕረት፡ እሠሀለኪ።
verses.translation: For a little while I left thee: but with great mercy will I have compassion upon thee.

translations.lxx: For a little while I left thee: but with great mercy will I have compassion upon thee.
translations.kjv: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
translations.ron: O clipă te-am părăsit, dar cu mari îndurări te iau lângă Mine.
translations.grk: Χρόνον μικρὸν κατέλιπόν σε, καὶ μετʼ ἐλέους μεγάλου ἐλεήσω σε.

verses.geez: በኅዳጥ፡ መዐት፡ ሜጥኩ፡ ገጽየ፡ እምኔኪ፡ ወበምሕረት፡ ዘለዓለም፡ እሠሀለኪ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘአድኀነኪ።
verses.translation: In a little wrath I turned away my face from thee; but with everlasting mercy will I have compassion upon thee, saith the Lord that delivers thee.

translations.lxx: In a little wrath I turned away my face from thee; but with everlasting mercy will I have compassion upon thee, saith the Lord that delivers thee.
translations.kjv: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
translations.ron: Într-o izbucnire de mânie, pentru o clipă Mi-am întors faţa de la tine, dar în îndurarea Mea cea veşnică Mă voi milostivi de tine, zice Răscumpărătorul tău, Domnul.
translations.grk: Ἐν θυμῷ μικρῷ ἀπέστρεψα τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀπὸ σοῦ, καὶ ἐν ἐλέει αἰωνίῳ ἐλεήσω σε, εἶπεν ὁ ῥυσάμενός σε Κύριος·

verses.geez: እምነ፡ ማይ፡ ዘአመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ስምዕየ፤ ዘከመ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ መሐልኩ፡ ለምድር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትመዐዓ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: From the time of the water of Noe this is my purpose: as I sware to him at that time, saying of the earth, I will no more be wroth with thee, neither when thou art threatened,

translations.lxx: From the time of the water of Noe this is my purpose: as I sware to him at that time, saying of the earth, I will no more be wroth with thee, neither when thou art threatened,
translations.kjv: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
translations.ron: Şi va fi ca în vremea lui Noe, când M-am jurat că apele potopului nu se vor mai răspândi pe pământ; tot aşa Mă jur acum să nu Mă mai mânii împotriva ta şi să nu te mai cert.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ ἐπὶ Νῶε τοῦτό μοι ἐστί· καθότι ὤμοσα αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ ἐκείνῳ, τῇ γῇ μὴ θυμωθήσεσθαι ἐπὶ σοὶ ἔτι, μηδὲ ἐν ἀπειλῇ σου τὰ ὄρη μεταστήσεσθαι,

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ኢይቅሥፎሙ፡ ለአድባር፡ ወኢያፈልሶሙ፣፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይትሐወሱ፡ አውግርኪ።
verses.translation: shall the mountains depart, nor shall thy hills be removed: so neither shall my mercy fail thee, nor shall the covenant of thy peace be at all removed: for the Lord who is gracious to thee has spoken it.

translations.lxx: shall the mountains depart, nor shall thy hills be removed: so neither shall my mercy fail thee, nor shall the covenant of thy peace be at all removed: for the Lord who is gracious to thee has spoken it.
translations.kjv: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
translations.ron: Munţii pot să se mute din loc şi colinele să se clatine, dar milostivirea Mea nu se va depărta de la tine şi legământul Meu de pace nu se va zdruncina, zice Domnul, Care are milă de tine.
translations.grk: οὐδʼ οἱ βουνοί σου μετακινηθήσονται· οὕτως οὐδὲ τὸ παρʼ ἐμοῦ σοι ἔλεος ἐκλείψει, οὐδὲ ἡ διαθήκη τῆς εἰρήνης σου οὐ μὴ μεταστῇ· εἶπε γὰρ ἵλεώς σοι Κύριε.

verses.translation: Afflicted and outcast thou hast not been comforted: behold, I will prepare carbuncle for thy stones, and sapphire for thy foundations;

translations.lxx: Afflicted and outcast thou hast not been comforted: behold, I will prepare carbuncle for thy stones, and sapphire for thy foundations;
translations.kjv: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
translations.ron: Sărmană, lovită de vijelie şi fără mângâiere! Iată, zidurile tale le voi împodobi cu pietre scumpe şi voi pune temelia ta pe safire.
translations.grk: Ταπεινὴ καὶ ἀκατάστατος οὐ παρεκλήθης· ἰδοὺ, ἐγὼ ἑτοιμάζω σοι ἄνθρακα τὸν λίθον σου, καὶ τὰ θεμέλιά σου σάπφειρον,

verses.geez: ወአረፋትኪ፡ ዘከርከዴን፡ ወአናቅጽኪ፡ ዘቢረሌ፡ ወአልባስኪኒ፡ ዘዕንቍ፡ ክቡር።
verses.translation: and I will make thy buttresses jasper, and thy gates crystal, and thy border precious stones.

translations.lxx: and I will make thy buttresses jasper, and thy gates crystal, and thy border precious stones.
translations.kjv: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
translations.ron: Şi-ii voi face crestele zidurilor de rubin şi porţile tale de cristal, iar împrejmuirea de pietre nestemate.
translations.grk: καὶ θήσω τὰς ἐπάλξεις σου ἴασπιν, καὶ τὰς πύλας σου λίθους κρυστάλλου, καὶ τὸν περίβολόν σου λίθους ἐκλεκτούς·

verses.geez: ወኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቅኪ፡ ምሁራን፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ወውስተ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ሰላም፡ ደቂቅኪ።
verses.translation: And I will cause all thy sons to be taught of God, and thy children to be in great peace.

translations.lxx: And I will cause all thy sons to be taught of God, and thy children to be in great peace.
translations.kjv: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
translations.ron: Toţi copiii tăi vor fi ucenici ai Domnului şi se vor bucura de mare fericire.
translations.grk: καὶ πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς σου διδακτοὺς Θεοῦ, καὶ ἐν πολλῇ εἰρήνῃ τὰ τέκνα σου.

verses.translation: And thou shalt be built in righteousness: abstain from injustice, and thou shalt not fear; and trembling shall not come nigh thee.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt be built in righteousness: abstain from injustice, and thou shalt not fear; and trembling shall not come nigh thee.
translations.kjv: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
translations.ron: Şi vei fi întemeiată pe dreptate: depărtează silnicia, căci nu ai de ce să te mai temi; leapădă şi groaza, căci nu se va mai apropia de tine.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ οἰκοδομηθήσῃ· ἀπέχου ἀπὸ ἀδίκου, καὶ οὐ φοβηθήσῃ, καὶ τρόμος οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ σοι.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ፈላስያን፡ ይመጽኡ፡ እንተ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወይትመሐፀኑ፡ ብኪ።
verses.translation: Behold, strangers shall come to thee by me, and shall sojourn with thee, and shall run to thee for refuge.

translations.lxx: Behold, strangers shall come to thee by me, and shall sojourn with thee, and shall run to thee for refuge.
translations.kjv: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
translations.ron: Dacă cineva va mai da năvală, nu este pornită de la Mine, şi cine se hărţuieşte cu tine va cădea în lupta împotriva ta!
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ προσήλυτοι προσελεύσονταί σοι διʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ παροικήσουσί σοι, καὶ ἐπὶ σὲ καταφεύξονται.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ አነ፡ እፈጥረኪ፤ አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ነሃቢ፡ ዘይበቍጽ፡ አፍሐመ፡ ወያወፅእ፡ ንዋየ፡ ምግባሩ፤ ወአንሰ፡ ፈጠርኩኪ፡ ለሠናይ፡ ወአኮ፡ ለሕርትምና።
verses.translation: Behold, I have created thee, not as the coppersmith blowing coals, and bringing out a vessel fit for work; but I have created thee, not for ruin, that I should destroy thee.

translations.lxx: Behold, I have created thee, not as the coppersmith blowing coals, and bringing out a vessel fit for work; but I have created thee, not for ruin, that I should destroy thee.
translations.kjv: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
translations.ron: Iată Eu am făcut pe meşterul, care suflă în focul de cărbuni şi făureşte arma cu meşteşugul lui, dar Eu am lăsat şi pe cel ce trebuie s-o nimicească.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἔκτισά σε, οὐχ ὡς χαλκεὺς φυσῶν ἄνθρακας, καὶ ἐκφέρων σκεῦος εἰς ἔργον· ἐγὼ δὲ ἔκτισά σε, οὐκ εἰς ἀπώλειαν φθεῖραι.

verses.geez: ወይትነሣእ፡ ኵሉ፡ ቃል፡ ወይትዋቀሠኪ፣፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ትመውኢዮሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ወይወርስዎሙ፡ ሰብእኪ።
verses.translation: I will not suffer any weapon formed against thee to prosper; and every voice that shall rise up against thee for judgment, thou shalt vanquish them all; and thine adversaries shall be condemned thereby. There is an inheritance to them that serve the Lord, and ye shall be righteous before me, saith the Lord.

translations.lxx: I will not suffer any weapon formed against thee to prosper; and every voice that shall rise up against thee for judgment, thou shalt vanquish them all; and thine adversaries shall be condemned thereby. There is an inheritance to them that serve the Lord, and ye shall be righteous before me, saith the Lord.
translations.kjv: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
translations.ron: Orice armă făurită împotriva ta nu va izbuti şi orice limbă oare se ridică la judecată cu tine osândită va fi. Aceasta este moştenirea slugilor Domnului şi dreptatea care vine de la Mine, zice Domnul.
translations.grk: Πᾶν σκεῦος σκευαστὸν ἐπὶ σὲ, οὐκ εὐοδώσω· καὶ πᾶσα φωνὴ ἀναστήσεται ἐπὶ σὲ εἰς κρίσιν, πάντας αὐτοὺς ἡττήσεις, οἱ δὲ ἔνοχοί σου ἔσονται ἐν αὐτῇ. Ἔστι κληρονομία τοῖς θεραπεύουσι Κύριον· καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔσεσθέ μοι δίκαιοι, λέγει Κύριος.
